title: Public Procurement Law: Bidding, Challenges, and KDB Review

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Public procurement (*közbeszerzés*) governs billions in state and EU expenditures. Contracting authorities must ensure transparency, equal treatment, and fair competition in tender specifications (*ajánlati felhívás*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Aggrieved bidders initiate review before the *Közbeszerzési Döntőbizottság (KDB)*. The KDB may suspend the procedure, annul unlawful decisions, or impose severe fines on infringing contracting authorities.
